review_notes: Read the whole file and checked Mathlib's ProfiniteGrp/Basic.lean for limitConeIsLimit and the preserves-limits instances. The epi proof and its helper are not repeated elsewhere in this file. The only repeated nontrivial machinery is the multiplicative/additive mono proof pair. I did not compile the proposed @[to_additive] version. The `ProfiniteAddGrp.limitConeIsLimit` and `PreservesLimits` instances are generated by to_additive in Mathlib, so the translation should go through. The exact instance-resolution form of the simplified proof is untested.

findings.problem: The same categorical argument is written twice, once for ProfiniteGrp (lines 48-62) and once for ProfiniteAddGrp (lines 169-183). It rebuilds PreservesLimit of the forgetful functor from the two limit cones, shows the forgetful functor preserves monos, and transfers CompHausLike.mono_iff_injective. The two blocks differ only by Grp/AddGrp. The file then links them with `attribute [to_additive existing]` at line 185, so a proof change has to be made twice by hand. The PreservesLimit construction is also redundant, because Mathlib already provides `@[to_additive] instance : Limits.PreservesLimits (forget₂ ProfiniteGrp Profinite)` with the same proof term.
findings.proposed_change:
Mark the multiplicative theorem `@[to_additive]` and delete the hand-written ProfiniteAddGrp copy, the `namespace ProfiniteAddGrp` block and the `attribute [to_additive existing]` line. Shorten the proof to use the existing instance:

@[to_additive]
theorem mono_iff_injective {G H : ProfiniteGrp.{u}} (f : G ⟶ H) : Mono f ↔ Function.Injective f := by
  constructor
  · intro _
    have : Mono ((forget₂ ProfiniteGrp Profinite).map f) :=
      preserves_mono_of_preservesLimit (forget₂ ProfiniteGrp Profinite) f
    exact (CompHausLike.mono_iff_injective ((forget₂ ProfiniteGrp Profinite).map f)).mp inferInstance
  · exact ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective f

The additive docstring can be given with `to_additive /-- ... -/`. Under their actual hypotheses, both uses (G H : ProfiniteGrp and G H : ProfiniteAddGrp) come from the one statement, since the needed instances are to_additive-generated in Mathlib.
findings.benefit: This removes about 15 duplicated lines and the `existing` bookkeeping, so the additive statement cannot drift from the multiplicative one. The proof also shrinks to the essential step: forget preserves monos, then use the CompHausLike characterization.
